title: Neighborhood Watch Log Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neighborhood:watch
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(patrol_zone) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many neighborhood watch log events land each day and how many distinct patrol zone values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest neighborhood watch log records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct patrol zone values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how much neighborhood watch log activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
